tools.name: get_shutdown_date
tools.description: Get the official deprecation/shutdown date, replacement and source for an AI model ID (e.g. gpt-4o-2024-08-06, claude-sonnet-4-5).

tools.name: list_upcoming
tools.description: List AI model shutdowns in the next N days, soonest first.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search all tracked AI models (including retired) by name.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: All tracked models for one provider (openai, anthropic, google-gemini, google-vertex, azure-openai, aws-bedrock, mistral, cohere).

tools.name: get_changes_since
tools.description: List tracked AI model records whose status, deprecation/shutdown date, replacement or source changed since an ISO 8601 time. Poll this to stay current.

tools.name: subscribe_alerts
tools.description: Subscribe to deprecation/shutdown change alerts. Give a public https webhook URL (JSON POST on every change, checked daily) or an email (double opt-in newsletter + alerts). Optional providers filter. Returns an unsubscribe token for webhooks.

tools.name: unsubscribe
tools.description: Stop webhook alerts using the token from subscribe_alerts. Email subscribers unsubscribe from the link in any email.
